priorityList: Summon Felguard and use Power Siphon pre-combat.
Use Potions, Racials, and on-use Trinkets while Demonic Tyrant is active.
Use Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer Demonic Core stacks remaining.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan whenever the Dominion of Argus buff is active.
Cast Grimoire: Imp Lord, Grimoire: Fel Ravager, and Summon Doomguard on cooldown.
Summon Demonic Tyrant once you reach 5 Soul Shards.
Cast Ruination whenever it is available.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan if you have 3 or more Soul Shards.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Demonbolt if you have Demonic Core stacks and fewer than 4 Soul Shards, prioritizing targets without Doom.
Cast Shadow Bolt as your basic generator filler.
